sessions.topic: Goal-based purchase flow
sessions.topicFull:
Goal-based purchase flow
Launch goal-based display and outstream products with defined product specs, pricing logic, and campaign setup flows. Internal launch readiness for products and prices is 21 October, customer communication starts in November, booking must be possible in November, and campaigns must be ready to deliver from 1 January 2027. Products must be available through direct sales and the Ad Manager self-service tool.

sessions.topic: Proof of results trough attention measurement

Proof of results trough attention measurement
Develop scalable attention measurement capabilities that strengthen campaign-effectiveness proof and differentiate Sanoma's advertising products. Define and document a validated Sanoma Attention Score methodology leveraging in-view and other engagement signals. Identify, validate and pilot a scalable solution for measuring attention in Outstream inventory
